semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized equipment and materials for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in MEMS and wet process applications.
summary: Semi-ence Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, offering advanced wet process and electroplating equipment through its representation of ClassOne Technology. It also collaborates with MEMS Star to provide cutting-edge MEMS equipment using proprietary dry release etch and deposition technologies. The company supplies high-purity materials like dense pyrolytic boron nitride and pyrolytic graphite, catering to MEMS, III-V, and telecommunications sectors.
capabilities: MEMS equipment with dry release etch and deposition technologies
Supply of dense pyrolytic boron nitride and pyrolytic graphite materials
